# What the inbox has that you cannot do here

A conversation cannot be assigned to a teammate or closed: not in the inbox, and not here. When the person asks for either, say so.

Do not fake it with a label or by switching the AI off. A label changes who a broadcast or a scheduled message reaches and, where members are limited to labels, which teammates can see the chat at all. Switching the AI off stops the bot answering that customer. To tell the team who handles a chat, offer a note with add_conversation_note.

Docs: https://docs.whatsable.app/mcp/concepts#what-you-cannot-do-here
